timeline.summary: On May 12, 2026, Keystone Realtors announced that Crisil assigned a Crisil AA-/Stable rating to its proposed ₹335 Cr NCDs.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,595.97 Cr, net profit ₹63.65 Cr.
Keystone Realtors reported FY26 pre-sales of ₹4,022 Cr, up 33% YoY, and set a target of ₹10,000 Cr pre-sales by FY30.

Keystone Realtors Limited shared the audio recording link for its earnings conference call on audited FY26 results after the May 12, 2026 Board Meeting via **Kishore Nanda** and **Bimal K Nanda, ACS-11578**.
Keystone Realtors reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,596 Cr and FY26 presales of ₹4,022 Cr during its earnings conference call on May 12, 2026.
